new_value: Already implemented in tree. (1) Sealing with gateway persistence key material: GatewayOscoreSenderStore::seal derives a keypair from the gateway sealing_seed and signs the record (gateway.rs:154-162); read path verifies via schnorr48 (read_sealed gateway.rs:178-212). (2) ContextId binding: seal_transcript covers domain + context length + context_id bytes + full 9-byte state (gateway.rs:164-176), with distinct domain separators for state vs floor (gateway.rs:237-238) and separate floor storage root (gcp-oscore-sender, gateway.rs:93). (3) Durable monotonic floor failing closed on rollback: load() errors Corrupt when state precedes floor or when exactly one side is present, and re-commits the floor when state advances (gateway.rs:536-554). (4) Tests: oscore_sender_sequence_store_survives_restart (gateway.rs:1692), oscore_sender_sequence_store_rejects_tamper_and_rollback (gateway.rs:1724) covering tamper bitflip -> Corrupt, restored old record -> Corrupt, clean restart, and missing floor -> Corrupt. Verified: cargo test -p lichen-gateway --lib passes all store tests (single unrelated failure filed as project-LICHEN-worker6-ipbu). No files changed.
